scope: Actual Jacobian local cotangents, Poincare deformation classes, naturality in square-zero coefficients and pointed curve pullback, geometric cotangent differential and its uniqueness. No Cartier or Verschiebung identification and no superspecial/supersingular classification theorem.
proof_adaptation: Wraps and combines the pinned P2mTJ Poincare-deformation helpers and P2mTJ1 actual local-ring construction. New quotient functoriality and the cotangent differential use scheme composition and the universal cotangent-valued infinitesimal point.
